error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
error.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

auth.session_expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.password_too_weak: Password must be at least {min} characters and mix at least two character types.

files.title: File manager
files.name: Name
files.deleteConfirm: Delete {count} selected items? This cannot be undone.

file.already_exists: Something with that name already exists.
file.is_directory: That is a folder, not a file.
file.not_text: This is a binary file and cannot be opened in the editor.
file.corrupt_archive: The archive is corrupt or in an unknown format.
file.unsafe_archive: The archive contains an unsafe entry ({entry}) trying to write outside the target folder.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.hint: Every command run here is written to the audit log.
terminal.not_supported: This platform does not support the terminal yet.

services.title: System services
services.name: Service
services.protectedHint: The panel refuses to stop this service so you cannot lock yourself out of the server.
services.managerUnavailable: This server has no usable service manager ({manager}).

service.manager_unavailable: The server has no usable service manager.
service.protected: Service {name} is protected by the panel and cannot be stopped or disabled.

cron.title: Scheduled tasks
cron.name: Task name
cron.deleteConfirm: Delete task {name} and all of its run history?
cron.commandHelp: Runs through the server shell with the panel's own privileges.
cron.workDirHelp: Leave empty to use the file manager root.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.unavailableHint: Neither ufw nor firewalld is installed on this server. Install one and reload the page.
firewall.portHelp: Single port (80) or range (8000:8100). Leave empty for any port.
firewall.sourceHelp: IP address or CIDR range. Leave empty for any source.
firewall.enableWarning: The panel opens the SSH port and its own port before enabling, so you keep your connection.
firewall.protectedHint: This port cannot be blocked for every source — you would lose access to the server. Blocking individual IPs is still allowed.

firewallErr.unavailable: The server has no usable firewall tool.
firewallErr.critical_port: Port {port} ({name}) cannot be blocked — you would lose access to the server.

docker.title: Docker
docker.name: Name
docker.pruneConfirm: Remove stopped containers and unused images? Volume data is not affected.
docker.protectedHint: This container runs the panel itself. Stopping it cuts your own access, and no button would remain to start it again.
docker.unavailableHint: Cannot reach Docker at {socket}. Check that Docker is installed and running.
docker.noLogs: This container has not written any log lines.

dockerErr.conflict: The action conflicts with the current state.
dockerErr.self_protected: This container runs the panel itself and cannot be stopped or removed from here.

apps.title: App store
apps.removeData: Also delete the data (cannot be undone)
apps.noneInstalled: Nothing installed yet. Pick an application from the Catalog tab.
apps.name: Install name
apps.nameHelp: Used as the directory and container name; lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores only.
apps.credentialsHint: These are the values used at install time, including any password the panel generated. Store them somewhere safe.
apps.copyFailed: The browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it manually.
apps.generateHint: Leave empty and the panel generates a random value.
apps.pullHint: The first install downloads these images: {images}. That can take a few minutes.
apps.composeUnavailable: Docker Compose is not installed on this server, so applications cannot be installed. Install Docker with the compose plugin.

appErr.catalog_not_found: Application {app} is not in the catalog.
appErr.name_exists: The name {name} is already used by another application.
appErr.dir_exists: Directory {dir} already exists from an earlier install. Pick another name, or uninstall the old one and delete its data.
appErr.port_in_use: Port {port} is already taken by another process.
appErr.compose_unavailable: Docker Compose is not available on this server.
appErr.install_failed: The install failed. Check the application logs for details.
appErr.action_failed: The action on this application failed.

db.title: Databases
db.removeConfirm: Remove server {name} from the panel? The data on that server is left untouched.
db.noServers: No servers yet. Add one to start managing databases.
db.userHelp: The administrative account the panel connects with, such as root or postgres.
db.passwordKeepHelp: Leave empty to keep the current password.
db.nameHelp: Letters, digits and underscores only; must start with a letter.
db.noDatabases: No databases yet, or no server selected.
db.dropConfirm: Drop database {name}? Every table and row inside it is lost and cannot be recovered.
db.noTables: This database has no tables yet.
db.noUsers: No users yet, or no server selected.
db.hostPatternHelp: Use % to allow connections from anywhere, or give one specific IP address.
db.dropUserConfirm: Drop user {name}? Applications using this account will lose their connection.
db.grantHelp: Pick a database to grant the new user full access to.
db.statementPlaceholder: Type an SQL statement and press Run
db.consoleWarning: Statements run verbatim with administrative privileges, including DROP and DELETE. There is no undo.

dbErr.invalid_name: Invalid name. Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
dbErr.connect_failed: Could not reach the server. Check the address, port, user and password.
dbErr.protected: This is a system object and cannot be modified.

backup.title: Backups
backup.deleted: Plan deleted. The backups it already made are kept.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete plan {name}? The backups it already made are kept.
backup.none: No backup plans yet. Nothing is being protected.
backup.name: Plan name
backup.pathHelp: Absolute path of the directory to back up.
backup.excludeHelp: Name patterns to skip, comma separated. For example node_modules, *.log
backup.dirHelp: Leave empty to use the panel's default backup directory.
backup.localWarning: A backup on the same machine only protects against mistakes, not against a failed disk or a lost server. Consider adding a second plan that ships to S3 or WebDAV.
backup.endpointHelp: For example https://s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com, or your own MinIO address.
backup.prefixHelp: Leave empty to store at the bucket root.
backup.webdavUrlHelp: URL of the storage folder, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/user/backups
backup.scheduleHelp: Five-field cron expression. Leave empty to run only on demand.
backup.keepDaysHelp: Set both and a backup must break both rules before it is deleted.
backup.noRuns: This plan has not run yet.
backup.noCopies: No backups at the destination yet.
backup.objectDeleteConfirm: Delete this backup? It cannot be recovered.
backup.restoreWarning: Restoring OVERWRITES the current data and cannot be undone. Make sure the current state is backed up first.
backup.targetHelp: Leave empty to restore over the original. Give a different name to restore somewhere new without touching live data.
backup.targetPlaceholder: Leave empty to restore in place

backupErr.invalid_config: The plan configuration is invalid at field {field}.
backupErr.destination_failed: The destination could not be used.
backupErr.dump_unavailable: The server is missing {tool}. Install the matching database client package.
backupErr.object_not_found: Backup file {object} was not found at the destination.

alert.title: Alerts
alert.noRules: No rules yet. The server will not tell you when something goes wrong.
alert.noChannelsWarning: There are no notification channels, so even a firing rule would reach nobody. Add one on the Channels tab.
alert.thresholdHelp: The alert fires when the metric goes above this value.
alert.durationHelp: The metric must stay above the threshold this long. Set 0 to alert immediately.
alert.cooldownHelp: Stops one long incident from sending hundreds of messages.
alert.targetsHelp: Leave empty to send to every enabled channel.
alert.channelDeleteConfirm: Delete channel {name}? Rules targeting it lose a recipient.
alert.testSent: Test notification sent. Check the receiving end.
alert.configKeepHint: Leave the configuration fields empty to keep the current values.
alert.chatIdHelp: Message the bot and read the chat id; group ids start with a minus sign.
alert.smtpPasswordHelp: Gmail requires an app password, not your account password.
alert.headersHelp: One "Name: value" per line, usually to carry an auth token.

apikey.title: API keys
apikey.name: Key name
apikey.nameHelp: Name it after where it is used, so you know which one to revoke later.
apikey.expiresHelp: Set 0 for a key that never expires.
apikey.revokeConfirm: Revoke key {name}? Any script using it stops working immediately.
apikey.hint: API keys let scripts call the API without embedding your account password. Send the key in the X-API-Key header, or as Authorization: Bearer.
apikey.showOnce: This is the only time the full key is shown — the server stores only a hash. Copy it now.
apikey.copyFailed: The browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it manually.

apikeyErr.invalid: The API key is invalid, disabled or expired.
apikeyErr.invalid_role: You cannot create a key with more privileges than your own account.

website.title: Websites
website.deleteConfirm: Delete website {name}? The config file is removed, the source files are kept.
website.name: Name
website.nameHelp: Used as the config file name; letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.
website.domainsHelp: One domain per line, or separated by commas.
website.rootHelp: Directory holding the site files; created if missing.
website.proxyTargetHelp: Service receiving the requests, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3000
website.certificateHelp: Pick a certificate from the SSL certificates tab.
website.forceHttpsHelp: Redirect every HTTP request to HTTPS.
website.extraConfigHelp: Inserted verbatim into the server block. Invalid syntax makes saving fail.
website.serverUnavailable: {server} was not found on this server. Install it before creating websites.
website.stagingHelp: Use the Let's Encrypt staging server: browsers will not trust the certificate, but it does not consume issuance limits.
website.emailHelp: Let's Encrypt uses this address to warn you before a certificate expires.
website.acmeHint: The domains must already point at this server and port 80 must be open, because Let's Encrypt connects back to verify them.
website.selfSignedHint: A self-signed certificate triggers a browser warning. Use it for testing, or before the domain points here.

websiteErr.apply_failed: The web server rejected the configuration. The previous config was restored.

certErr.key_mismatch: The private key does not match the certificate.
certErr.issue_failed: Could not obtain the certificate. Check that the domain resolves here and port 80 is open.
certErr.in_use: The certificate is in use by website {websites}.
